name: Mikhail Jones
current_role: Co-Founder, Agility (Agility Robotics); last listed as VP of Software (unverified profile)
profile: One of three co-founders of Agility Robotics (2015, with Jonathan Hurst and Damion Shelton), spun out of Oregon State University's Dynamic Robotics Lab where he had been a research engineer. Agility builds the Cassie biped and the Digit humanoid for logistics and manufacturing and is valued around 2.5B USD.
interesting_fact: Agility grew out of OSU research on spring-mass bipedal walking (ATRIAS), leading to the ostrich-like Cassie in 2017 and the humanoid Digit.
notes: Very low public profile; not listed on Agility's current leadership page, so his current role is unclear (theorg.com, unverified, lists VP of Software and prior OSU Faculty Research Assistant). Best route is via Agility press or co-founders. Research cut short by web-search quota.

name: Huss El-Sheikh
profile: Hussam 'Huss' El-Sheikh co-founded 9fin in 2016 with Steven Hunter after a career in investment-bank technology at Deutsche Bank. As CTO he built 9fin's AI-native debt-market intelligence platform (news, data, analytics for leveraged finance, distressed, CLOs, private credit), used by 350+ institutions; the company has raised 250M+ USD and reached unicorn valuation.
interesting_fact: 9fin describes itself as having been 'deploying AI for debt markets' for nine years - long before the generative-AI wave - and now offers an MCP connector so AI agents can query its credit data.
deep_cut_fact: He trained as an aerospace engineer (MEng, University of Bristol) and joined Deutsche Bank as a graduate analyst, rising to Associate Vice President in Prime Finance, Equities and Derivatives Technology before co-founding 9fin.
notes: team@9fin.com is a general inbox. 9fin's reporters actively cover data-center/neocloud debt financing - a natural podcast angle.
